description:
This file defines the deterministic course registration workflow for citizen nwo-citizen0001, Pat Tarwater Jr, as part of the onboarding process for the Information Technology program at South University. It is designed for integration into Beast System 3.0 and provides a structured, repeatable sequence that outlines how to prepare for, initiate, and complete course registration without storing sensitive personal identifiers. The workflow ensures academic alignment with the strategic objectives of New World Order DAO and Beast System 3.0.

The workflow includes the following phases: Phase 1: Curriculum Review, directing the citizen to examine the official South University IT curriculum, identify required foundational courses, and map them to organizational skill priorities. Phase 2: Advisor Consultation, providing space to document communication with the assigned academic advisor, including recommended first-term courses and long-term academic planning. Phase 3: Portal Access Preparation, outlining steps to access the university’s student portal, verify login credentials, and review registration tools. Phase 4: Course Selection, detailing how to choose first-term courses based on prerequisites, workload balance, and alignment with Beast System 3.0 development goals. Phase 5: Registration Execution, guiding the citizen through the official registration process on South University’s secure portal. Phase 6: Confirmation and Documentation, providing structure for recording registered courses, schedules, and any required follow-up actions.

This file serves as a canonical reference for Beast System 3.0 academic modules, ensuring consistency and alignment with organizational growth objectives. It does not perform registration automatically; instead, it provides a deterministic structure that the citizen manually follows to maintain security and compliance.
